title: Lower City Orientation — Survival Notice
location: General Access Terminal — Lower City Public Kiosk, Canyon Level
author: Unknown — Hand-amended multiple times
content:
YOU ARE IN THE LOWER CITY.

The red flags up top don't reach down here most of the time. Check before you assume. A building that was flagged yesterday might not be today.

The rules are simple: there are no rules. Except about the environmental systems. Touch those and the Widows will come down personally, and they will not be in a mood to talk about it.

Survival advice from whoever last used this terminal:

— Don't walk alone after the lights drop to half-cycle.
— Don't flash currency. Don't flash gear. Don't flash anything.
— If someone offers to show you somewhere 'quieter,' they are going to rob you. Or worse.
— The Blood Gangs cut organs out of tourists. This is not a metaphor.
— Tuk's bar is actually safe. The K'Kree owner will throw you out before she lets anything happen inside. Outside is your problem.
— Brain Dimming will sell you anything. Some of it will kill you. That is not their concern.
— The Church of the Traveller is not dangerous unless you stay long enough to hear the sermon.

title: Tuk's Bar — House Rules
location: General Access Terminal — Tuk's Bar, Lower City
author: 'Tuk — Proprietor
content:
HOUSE RULES. READ THEM.

1. You pay before you drink. Not after. Before.
2. You do not start fights in here.
3. If someone else starts a fight in here, you do not finish it in here. You take it outside. I will help you take it outside.
4. You do not ask me what something is before you order it. You ask what it costs.
5. The menu is vegetarian. It has always been vegetarian. If you don't like it, there are twelve other establishments within three hundred meters where you can get whatever died recently. Go there.
6. I am the only bouncer. I am sufficient.
7. If you are being followed, come in. I will handle the door. You do not owe me anything for this. Consider it a professional courtesy from one being who has been around too long to let things happen in their own establishment.

—

Note on current clientele: I don't share that. I don't know you well enough yet.

Note on current local gossip: Someone is moving money through the Scrapheap. A name has been mentioned more than once. I said I don't share things, but I also said you should read the rules. I don't share things about my paying customers. You are not a paying customer yet. [[connect: scrapheap]]

Order something.

title: Church of the Traveller — Public Doctrine
location: General Access Terminal — Church of the Traveller, Lower City
author: Church of the Traveller — Doctrinal Office
content:
THE CHURCH OF THE TRAVELLER — A NOTICE TO THE CURIOUS

We believe that God is travelling.

Not metaphorically. Literally. God moves through the universe in the form of a mortal being, observing Humaniti — and perhaps other species — in order to judge us. God walks among us. God has a face. God is hungry, tired, cold, and watching.

We do not know which face is God's.

This uncertainty is the point.

Some among us practice charity and kindness for this reason. If the stranger at your door might be God, you feed them. You shelter them. You treat them as you would wish to be treated by something infinite.

Some among us practice something else. If God is watching, then every act is witnessed. Every sin is seen. Some take comfort in this. Some find it clarifying in other ways.

We do not litigate the theology here. We welcome all interpretations.

We are particularly active on Theev because we find that people in lawless places are more open to questions about judgment than people elsewhere.

Special Notice:

The midnight sermon mentions a star map. Something about a place between the stars where things are 'waiting to be remembered.' Brother Aeshan says he dreamed it. He won't say what he dreamed exactly. He has started to say that the stars are wrong and that something older than God is also watching.

title: Brain Dimming — Product Notice (Partial)
location: General Access Terminal — Brain Dimming, Lower City
author: Brain Dimming — Management
content:
BRAIN DIMMING — WE HAVE WHAT YOU NEED.

And things you didn't know you needed.

Species we currently cater to: Human, Vargr, Aslan, K'Kree (limited stock), Droyne (very limited stock — ask at the desk, do not ask why we have it), and several we have not successfully identified.

Current notable stock:

— Psionic-adjacent compounds: Three varieties. Effects inconsistent across users. One variety has produced vivid shared visual hallucinations in group settings — the imagery reportedly includes 'black towers,' 'blue light in deep stone,' and 'something with too many angles.' We do not know what this means. It keeps selling.

— Memory suppression: Popular with people who have done things they would prefer not to remember. Not a cure. The memories are still there afterward.

— One compound acquired from an off-world trader two cycles ago. Trader described it as 'distilled from something we found in a derelict.' We have not catalogued it. We have not sold it. The bottle hums faintly at irregular intervals. We have put it in the back room.

We do not guarantee outcomes. We do not guarantee survival. We have never had a refund claim because the people who regret their purchases are generally not in a position to file one.

title: Blood Gang Activity — Widow Internal Report
location: General Access Terminal — Lower City Public Kiosk, Canyon Level
author: Widow Administrative Office — Street Level Division
content:
BLOOD GANG ACTIVITY — INTERNAL SUMMARY — DAY 212 · 1105

Seven incidents in the lower canyon over the last three days.

Five involving visitors. Standard method: follow, isolate, take organs and currency. Three victims recovered. Two not.

One incident involving a known informant. Likely targeted. We are noting this but not acting on it. The lower city enforces its own logic.

One incident involving a refugee from Asharden Camp. Female, mid-twenties, offworlder accent. She reached Tuk's by herself. The K'Kree took her in for the night and the incident was closed on our books the moment it crossed her threshold. Whoever followed her is still in the canyon. — Intake record: [[connect: asharden_lore]]

—

Note of interest: Three Blood Gang members were found dead near the Scrapheap access tunnel two nights ago. No visible wounds. One had a look on his face that our officer described as 'like he heard something.' We are logging this as a jurisdictional matter.

Note of interest: The Scrapheap has seen unusual foot traffic. Small boys, mostly. Running errands. Taking messages. This pattern is consistent with a fixer operating from inside the Scrapheap. We have not identified the fixer. We are watching. [[connect: scrapheap]]

Note of interest: A Vethis Carriage field pair has been observed standing near the freight elevator at three levels down for the last two bells. They are not Blood Gang. They are not ours. They are waiting for someone.

— Flag for elevated observation if new arrivals approach the Scrapheap, the freight elevator, or the Asharden refugee traffic corridor.

title: Church of the Traveller — Brother Aeshan's Coordinate Record
location: General Access Terminal — Church of the Traveller, Lower City
author: Church of the Traveller — Doctrinal Archive (Private Partition)
content:
The Church of the Traveller maintains a private doctrinal archive alongside its public records. Brother Aeshan has been filing personal entries for several months. The public sermon mentions 'a place between the stars where things are waiting to be remembered.'

Aeshan has been recording coordinates. He says he dreams them. He will not discuss them in public.

[INTERACTIVE TERMINAL — AWAITING INPUT]

lines: >> CHURCH OF THE TRAVELLER — DOCTRINAL ARCHIVE v1.0
>> PUBLIC RECORDS: ACCESSIBLE
>> PRIVATE DOCTRINAL FILES: ENCRYPTED
>> AESHAN, BROTHER — PERSONAL ENTRIES: 14 FILES
>> MOST RECENT ENTRY: 9 DAYS AGO
>> ENCRYPTION: STANDARD ECCLESIASTICAL — LOW GRADE
>> INITIATING DECRYPT...
>> RECOVERED — AESHAN PRIVATE ENTRY, MOST RECENT:
>> 'I HAVE NOW DREAMED IT SEVENTEEN TIMES.'
>> 'THE COORDINATES DO NOT MATCH ANY IMPERIAL CHART.'
>> 'NOT A WORLD. A SCAR. SOMETHING HIT IT.'
>> 'IT IS STILL THERE. IT SHOWS ON CHARTS AS A GRAVITATIONAL ANOMALY.'
>> 'THREE DREAMERS HAVE REACHED IT. THEY DO NOT COME BACK.'
>> 'NOT TO US. PERHAPS TO SOMETHING ELSE.'
>> COORDINATE STRING (RAW): [APPENDED TO RECORD]
>> NOTE: COORDINATE DOES NOT APPEAR IN ANY KNOWN DATABASE.

on_complete.message: Brother Aeshan's private entries are methodical — a churchman recording something he cannot explain in the only framework he has. Seventeen dreams. The same place each time. A gravitational anomaly that doesn't appear in Imperial charts or any standard navigation database. He has been sending the coordinates to no one. He does not know who to tell. Three people, he writes, have already gone there — pilgrims who took his words literally. None returned. He is not sure if he considers that a tragedy or confirmation.

on_failure.message: DECRYPT FAILED. Ecclesiastical archive lock held — the Church uses a rotating key that expired after Brother Aeshan's last entry. The files cannot be accessed without a current key, which only Aeshan has.

title: Vethis Carriage — Recovery Notice (Posted)
location: General Access Terminal — Lower City Public Kiosk, Canyon Level
author: Vethis Carriage Recovery Division — Field Pair 7
content:
VETHIS CARRIAGE — VOLUNTARY RECOVERY NOTICE

We are seeking the current custodian of a 200-ton Far Trader hull, Imperial registry. The hull was reported stolen from a bonded yard approximately fourteen months ago. Current location is believed to be Theev, under third-party holding.

Vethis Carriage does not pursue criminal charges against parties who facilitate voluntary return. We do pursue charges against parties who actively obstruct recovery after notification.

We are aware that the hull is currently held at Kallos Shipyards under a private arrangement. We are aware that the arrangement involves parties who prefer not to be identified. We are not interested in those parties. We are interested in the hull.

Contact: Inquiries may be directed to the Grand Hotel, Upper City, Rooms 16 and 17. A representative is available between 0800 and 2000. Outside these hours, leave a message with the front desk.

—

NOTE: We are also seeking information regarding a separate matter — a sealed data chip deposited in the Cliff District Vault under the Tobia Commerce Guild reference approximately fourteen days ago. We believe this chip contains information relevant to the hull's current custodian. If the chip's contents have already been accessed, we would appreciate knowing what they contained.

We pay well for useful information. We are, as noted, practical people.

title: Brother Aeshan — Public Sermon Transcript
location: General Access Terminal — Lower City Public Kiosk, Canyon Level
author: Unknown — Transcribed by a curious attendee
content:
I went to the midnight sermon. I don't usually. I was curious after reading the church's public notice.

This is what I remember. It wasn't recorded officially so I wrote it down after.

—

Brother Aeshan said:

'God is travelling. We have always said this. But tonight I want to talk about what travels with God.'

'There are older things. Things that were here before the first ships, before the first fire, before whatever it was that made us look up and want to go further. Those things are also travelling. They have been travelling longer than we have. They remember the universe before we were in it.'

'I have been shown a place. I do not know why I was shown it and others were not. I did not ask to dream it. The place is not on any chart I have found. It is a scar. Something struck it from a very great height, a very long time ago. The thing that struck it left something behind.'

'Three members of this congregation have gone to find it. I do not know if they arrived. I have not heard from them. I am choosing to believe they arrived.'

'I am going to give the coordinates to anyone who asks for them tonight. After tonight I am going to stop. I have been having the dream more frequently. I think the place has noticed me noticing it.'

—

I asked for the coordinates at the end. So did eight other people. Brother Aeshan looked at each of us for a long time before he wrote anything down.

He gave me a piece of paper. I have not opened it yet.

I don't know why I haven't opened it yet.

She's been expecting visitors. She is not alarmed. Whatever she's planning, multiple arrivals were already part of it.
